validated_ilocano: Addaak ditoy Tam-Awan Village ita, ket agpapanak koma iti SM City Baguio.
english_translation: I am here in Tam-Awan Village now, and I was going to go to SM City Baguio.
filipino_translation: Nasa Tam-Awan Village ako ngayon, at papunta sana ako sa SM City Baguio.

validated_ilocano: Ti paggapuak ket Baguio City National High School. Mabalin kadi a iturongnak iti Sunshine Park?
english_translation: My starting point is Baguio City National High School. Could you please show me the way to Sunshine Park?
filipino_translation: Ang pinanggalingan ko ay Baguio City National High School. Maaari po ba ninyong ituro sa akin ang daan papuntang Sunshine Park?

validated_ilocano: Pakiturongannak man iti Lourdes Grotto. Addaak pay laeng iti Mines View Park.
english_translation: Please direct me to the Lourdes Grotto. I was still in Mines View Park.
filipino_translation: Pakituro naman sa akin ang daan papunta sa Lourdes Grotto. Nasa Mines View Park pa ako noon.
